subject: Request: AsterWave pilot - combined credit & term override
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Greene <tom.greene@asterwave.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal and trial credit offer

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I've put together a compact pilot offer so AsterWave can validate the integration and latency profiles against your production-grade dataset. High level:

- 30,000 token credits prepaid for the 30-day pilot
- 30-day trial window from the date of sandbox access
- Dedicated onboarding hours (4) from our integration team

If this looks reasonable I can generate a one-page quote and send to your procurement. If you need more runway or credits to cover larger evaluation runs, tell me what scale you expect and I’ll escalate.

Attachments: AW-pilot-quote-20270521.pdf (draft)

Next steps:
1) You confirm scope and expected token burn.
2) We finalize quote and DocuSign.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
From: Tom Greene <tom.greene@asterwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal and trial credit offer

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Two items from my side:

1) Our initial runs indicate we'll likely consume ~70k tokens over the pilot because we need multiple long-form prompts and stress tests across three teams.
2) Procurement will need at least a 45-day evaluation window to line up SOC 2 evidence and network routing tests.

Can Redwood do a combined exception: bump credits to cover the 70k and extend the trial to 45 days? If we can get that, I can push this through faster on my side (and cascade a PO).

Tom
Tom Greene
Head of Platform | AsterWave Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AsterWave request — escalation for exec approval

Team — forwarding AsterWave's ask. They want: 70k credits (vs the 30k we offered) and a 45-day trial window. Deal context:
- Account: AsterWave Labs (early-stage, strong integration fit for our streaming API with low-latency requirements)
- ACV upside: $80k ARR if pilot converts to a 1-year committed plan (estimate from the product-fit call)
- Region: US; procurement timeline could stretch if we can't meet the eval window

Options I'm proposing for an approval ask:
A) Approve 60k credits + 45-day extension + 15% onboarding discount (middle ground)
B) Approve full 70k credits + 45-day extension but require signed LOI/PO within 21 days of DocuSign to redeem credits

Costs: credits are prepaid consumption credits; the marginal cost for the extra tokens at our current rate is manageable for strategic signals here, but we'd be setting an exception.

Can I get a decision to present back to Tom? If approved, I'll attach final quote and DocuSign link.

-Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AsterWave request — escalation for exec approval

Jordan —

Thanks for the context. I'm comfortable approving a constrained exception with clear guardrails. Approve option B with a tweak:

- Approve 60,000 pilot credits (not the full 70k)
- Approve 45-day trial extension
- Offer 15% onboarding services discount (one-time)
- Condition: Customer must sign an LOI or submit a PO within 21 calendar days of DocuSign issuance. If they miss the window, remaining credits revert.

Rationale: preserves leverage while accommodating their procurement needs. Vivek, please confirm there are no infra constraints on our side for a 45-day sandbox. Neha, confirm finance is ok with the credited amount and discount accounting.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Greene <tom.greene@asterwave.com>, Procurement <procure@asterwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot proposal and trial credit offer — approved exception

Tom — good news. Leadership approved a constrained exception to help you run the wider evaluation. Summary of what we can offer:

- 60,000 prepaid pilot token credits (applied at sandbox activation)
- 45-day trial window from sandbox start
- 15% discount on onboarding services (one-time)
- Condition: LOI or PO to be submitted within 21 days of DocuSign to unlock remaining credits and discounts

I've attached the updated quote and a short terms summary. DocuSign link to follow in the next email so your procurement can review.

Attachments: AW-pilot-quote-20270521.pdf, terms_summary_asterwave.xlsx
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/sign/asterwave-aw-pilot

Next steps:
1) I will send DocuSign this afternoon.
2) Procurement reviews terms; once DocuSign is signed we provision sandbox and apply credits.

Appreciate you pushing this — let me know if procurement wants any language adjustments before the doc goes live.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
